name: EPIC 246098763

text.card: A red giant 3,325 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 1.27 solar masses and 10.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,991 K at its surface.
